name: kmj-desktop-commander
description: Policy-controlled autonomous engineering workflows for customer-controlled development machines and servers.

interface.shortDescription: Safe autonomous engineering on your own machines and servers.
interface.longDescription: Use KMJ Desktop Commander to inspect projects, plan verified engineering work, run allow-listed quality gates, and coordinate policy-controlled changes on customer-controlled development systems. Privileged and destructive operations remain approval-gated.
defaultPrompt: Use KMJ Desktop Commander to inspect my project and tell me the safest next engineering task.
Use KMJ Desktop Commander to run the relevant quality gates and summarize verified failures.
Use KMJ Desktop Commander to fix a safe project issue, retest it, and report the evidence.
